label: SYNTHETIC PREPARATION ONLY. No customer, request, order, payment or revenue. Not browser-tested, no Shopify import tested, no private-cycle integration observed.

mode_input_only.how: transform.py exits 2 and lists line-numbered errors in --report JSON (stdout only gives error_count); e.g. "variants line 3: duplicate SKU SYN-A-BL-40 (first line 2)"
mode_input_only.NOT_supported: Preservation checks (SKU/barcode/color/size/price preserved, every image once, variant image = first of color). Without client output rows, verify.py can only check OUR own conversion (12/12 passed), which says nothing about the client's file and must not be reported as preservation.

limits: verify.py gives pass/fail per check only, no row or SKU location; the inline report must add a manual row-by-row diff by the agent for each failed check

header_matches_documented_names fails on any extra/missing column (e.g. Body (HTML)); utf8_no_bom_lf_only fails on CRLF. Real agency files from the full Shopify template will usually fail these two even when data is right: report them as format-difference-from-our-subset, not as defects

limit_enforcement: 21 variant rows were accepted by transform.py (exit 0); the 20-row cap must be checked manually at intake
offer_corrections_needed: State that preservation/image checks need the produced Shopify rows; input-only requests get input validation only
Say the report names failed checks and the agent locates rows manually; no automated row-level diff
Say the two format checks compare against our documented column subset, not Shopify acceptance
Public page change needs a reviewed dry_run digest; not done here
verdict: DELIVERABLE_WITH_CORRECTIONS for the two modes above; no demand or revenue evidence
